purpose: Glass-box registry of what each Cursor agent rule, skill, and governed capability does. Nothing agent-facing is active unless listed here.

agents.does: Implements product code, tests, docs, and API changes under registered rules and skills.

registry.does: Requires unit, functional, integration, regression, black-box, and E2E tests on every implementation, plus self-verification before done.
Requires a dedicated versioned git branch for the next version of an implementation (feat/<area>-vN).
Requires all public HTTP APIs under /api/v{N}/... (e.g. /api/v1/profile); breaking changes create vN+1.
Requires every new or changed agent rule, skill, hook, or governed capability to be registered in .cursor/governance.json.
Lazy-senior mode: smallest complete change; levels lite/full/ultra; pairs with review/audit/debt/gain/help skills.
UI/UX design intelligence: design systems, styles, typography, accessibility, and stack-specific UI guidance.
